name: Scope by Ouroboros
description: Stores a freelancer's approved scope, rates, deadlines, and change orders so an AI assistant reads the approved record before it answers. The assistant cannot invent a discount or promise work that was not approved. Tools: list_engagements, create_engagement, get_approved_record, save_scope_item, save_rate, save_deadline, approve_scope, file_change_order, approve_change_order. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/scope. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/scope. Made by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
